landing.hero_pill: AI-powered market intelligence for better selling decisions
landing.hero_desc: Compare market prices, discover suitable buyers and make confident, profitable selling decisions.
landing.how_it_works_desc: From crop input to final transaction, AgriMitra simplifies agricultural commerce in four easy steps.
landing.step1_desc: Select your harvested crop, quantity in kg, location, and quality grade (Grade A/B/C).
landing.step2_desc: Instantly view modal prices across nearby APMC Mandis along with estimated transport costs.
landing.step3_desc: Our AI Sell Advisor evaluates price trends, volatility, and net returns to recommend the best market window.
landing.step4_desc: Connect with verified institutional buyers looking for your produce lot and complete secure transactions.
landing.realtime_apmc_desc: AgriMitra uses latest available daily APMC data to give you indicative modal prices across nearby markets.
landing.ai_forecaster_desc: Our machine learning models analyze historical trends and seasonal volatility to predict where prices are heading in the next 5 days.
landing.risk_advisor_desc: We don't just tell you the price. We evaluate transport costs, storage availability, and downside risks to tell you if you should Sell Now or Wait.
landing.direct_matching_desc: Skip the intermediaries. Get matched instantly with verified buyers, traders, and FPOs looking for your exact crop and quality grade.
landing.why_choose_desc: We are building the most transparent, efficient, and profitable agricultural marketplace for Indian farmers.
landing.transparency_desc: No hidden fees, no opaque commissions. You see the exact price the buyer is offering.
landing.verified_network_desc: Every buyer and FPO on the platform undergoes strict KYC verification for safe transactions.
landing.ready_desc: Join thousands of farmers making smarter selling decisions daily.
landing.footer_copyright: © 2026 AgriMitra. All rights reserved for SIH.
landing.market_intelligence_desc: Understand modal prices, price trends, nearby mandis, and net profit expectations before transporting your crop.
landing.why_transparent_desc: Smallholders often lose 15-25% of their crop value due to lack of local market visibility and high transportation costs. AgriMitra combines nearby mandi prices with net transport calculations so you never sell below fair market value.
landing.smart_market_desc: AgriMitra analyzes available market data to help identify a suitable market and selling window. By evaluating historical price trends, volatility, and arrival volumes, the advisor estimates expected prices and confidence levels.
landing.ai_assisted_estimate: AI-assisted estimate based on prototype market data.
landing.direct_buyer_desc: Eliminating unnecessary intermediaries by connecting farmers and FPOs directly to verified corporate buyers.
landing.real_capabilities: Real functional capabilities active inside this AgriMitra hackathon prototype.
landing.desc: Empowering Indian farmers & FPOs with transparent daily market price intelligence, direct buyer connections, and actionable agricultural intelligence.
landing.prototype_disclaimer: SIH Hackathon Prototype. Latest daily mandi data when available, with AI-assisted estimation.
